title: Steelers place rare right-of-first-refusal tag on QB Aaron Rodgers

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Steelers place rare right-of-first-refusal tag on QB Aaron Rodgers
sources.description: After being leapfrogged in the draft for USC receiver Makai Lemon, the Steelers move to prevent a repeat, placing an uncommon right-of-first-refusal tender on quarterback Aaron Rodgers
